title: Service Concession Arrangements: Disclosure
summary: Addresses disclosure requirements for service concession arrangements, applying to both operators and grantors, and requiring information that enables users to evaluate the nature and extent of such arrangements.

related.title: Service Concession Arrangements
related.relationship: Supplies the recognition and measurement framework SIC-29's disclosures relate to, primarily from the operator's perspective

related.title: Presentation of Financial Statements
related.relationship: Supplies the general principles of financial statement presentation and materiality that inform how SIC-29 disclosures are structured

related.title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
related.relationship: Governs any restoration/handback obligations disclosed as part of a service concession arrangement's terms
